name: shot-bay
prompt: Tilt-shift photograph of a handmade miniature diorama like an architect's model on a table, seen from above at a gentle three-quarter angle, shallow depth of field, tiny model people, warm sand, terracotta and sage-green palette. Close on the loading bay of a pale Indian snack factory with a sawtooth roof and two tall brick chimneys, in low golden morning light with long soft shadows, under a sky of pale rose and gold. A small blue truck stands at the bay with its tailgate down, and tiny workers pass brown cardboard cartons from the bay into the truck. In front of the truck a tiny woman from the factory's office in a kurta, holding a phone, and a tiny man in a checked shirt, the distributor, shake hands, both smiling. Behind them the small two-storey office with a balcony and a lit window. A thin softly glowing green painted path begins at the bay and runs out along the road. No lettering, no words or numbers on any sign, paper or screen, no logos.
postprocess: WebP q82; the PNG original stays local in src/
use: smartclearance.com's hero film (SC-111): a plate of the journey's day, and a poster for the film
